summary: Practise adaptive decisions, team capacity reviews and learning routines in a five-day leadership agility course. Explore the course outline.
lede: Leadership agility helps team leads, operations supervisors and project leads adjust priorities and coordinate work as conditions change. This foundation-level course uses Adaptive Leadership, the OODA loop and After Action Review to practise decision ownership, escalation, and workload and capacity checks. Learners also build routines for hybrid handoffs, team learning reviews and evidence-based improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who guide teams through changing priorities, service interruptions or uncertain delivery conditions. It suits people building foundational leadership agility and team resilience practices.
prerequisites: No coding is required. Experience coordinating work or supervising a team will help you apply the scenarios to your role.
